profile.reading: This facility, ORD-02, sits on Aligned own Chicago area campus in Northlake, Illinois, at a published address of 501 Northwest Ave, Northlake, IL 60164, on an 18.5 acre site. Aligned describes ORD-02 as the first data center to achieve OCP Ready certification for hyperscale use, and states the facility is designed to Tier III standards with a 100 percent uptime SLA. No IT capacity or total square footage figure is published for this building.

reading.body:
Northlake ORD-02 is the first data center certified as OCP Ready for hyperscale deployment, and is designed to Tier III availability standards, but the operator publishes no IT load or building footprint figures that would let a reader assess its actual size or role in AI infrastructure scaling. The 18.5 acre campus site suggests room for growth or co-location of additional facilities beyond this single building.

Illinois has mapped 44 data center facilities, but only 6 publish power consumption figures, for a state total of 236 MW across operators. ORD-02 is ranked seventh in Illinois by published capacity, a position that reflects both its operator's broader footprint in the region and the fact that most data center operators in the state do not disclose their power draws.

Aligned operates 50 campuses across North America with over 5 GW of announced capacity, and as of early 2025 secured acquisition terms valuing the company at approximately 40 billion dollars, expected to close in the first half of 2026. Without published capacity for ORD-02 itself, this facility cannot be weighed independently against other AI-ready hyperscale sites, but its hyperscale certification and operator scale suggest it is engineered to support large-scale training workloads if deployed to that purpose.
